pro_course_detail.description:
Master Your Next Job Interview with Confidence!

Are you preparing for a job interview in English and feeling nervous about making the right impression? Whether you're aiming for a role in banking, insurance, or any other industry, this lesson is designed to help you shine in your interview and land your dream job!

With my extensive experience working in banking and insurance on Wall Street and successfully running my own business in Canada, I bring real-world insights and practical strategies to help you succeed. This lesson is perfect for professionals, students, or anyone looking to improve their interview skills in English.                                                                          
What You’ll Learn:
Common Interview Questions & Answers:

Practice responding to questions like "Tell me about yourself," "What are your strengths and weaknesses?" and "Why should we hire you?"

Learn how to structure your answers clearly and confidently.

Industry-Specific Vocabulary:

Master key terms and phrases used in banking, insurance, and business.

Learn how to discuss your skills, experience, and achievements professionally.

Cultural Nuances & Body Language:

Understand the expectations of English-speaking interviewers.

Learn how to use body language, tone, and eye contact to make a positive impression.

Behavioral Interview Techniques:

Prepare for situational and behavioral questions (e.g., "Describe a time you solved a problem" or "How do you handle stress?").

Use the STAR method (Situation, Task, Action, Result) to craft compelling responses.

Mock Interviews & Personalized Feedback:

Participate in realistic mock interviews tailored to your target industry.

Receive constructive feedback on your language, content, and delivery.

Follow-Up Strategies:

Learn how to write a professional thank-you email after the interview.

Understand the next steps and how to follow up effectively.

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS Preparation - Speaking
pro_course_detail.description:
If you have not done a TRIAL LESSON with me, our first lesson (and first lesson only) will start with a diagnostic speaking exam. This is the best way to immediately identify your strengths & weakness to make a plan moving forward. During this lesson you will get VERY specific feedback using the IELTS Speaking Band Descriptor so you understand approximately how your doing. 
- a 30-minute diagnostic will involve limited feedback, but might just be a good way to practice with a general idea of your approximate level.
- a 60-minute diagnostic will give us time for much more detailed feedback as well as some strategies to deal with issues. Plus, there will be a little extra time at the end of class for a bit more practice.

After a diagnostic lesson, all future lessons are 60 minutes. Our classes will focus on Speaking Exam Preparation Skills so you will understand what is expected during the test. These skills include, but are not limited to: 
- Giving structured responses
- Displaying grammatical knowledge
- Paraphrasing

In each class, I will introduce you to the specific skill and give you plenty of opportunity to practice it. I will never promise you a certain Band Score, but I promise you will better be able to achieve a score representative of your actual level.

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS Preparation - Writing
pro_course_detail.description:
If you have NOT already done a TRIAL LESSON with me, our first lesson will start with a diagnostic writing evaluation. You will be required to submit a sample/samples of your IELTS writing before the class so we can discuss them during the lesson. This is the best way to immediately identify your strengths & weakness to make a plan moving forward. During the lesson, you will get VERY specific feedback using the IELTS Writing Band Descriptor so you understand approximately how your doing. We can do either General or Academic writing, Task 1 or Task 2
- a 30-minute diagnostic will involve one writing sample; either Task 1 or Task 2. NOT both. 
- a 60-minute diagnostic will allow for two writing samples; typically it is most useful to do one Task 1 and one Task 2

After doing a diagnostic, all lesson will be 60 minutes. Any packages might include a number of specific skills necessary to meet the IELTS assessment criteria. These include, but are not limited to:
- Maintaining consistent and appropriate tone
- Addressing the requirements of the task
- Presenting a clear purpose
- Logical organization 
- Paragraphing
- Demonstrating a range of cohesive devices

In each class, I will introduce a certain skill, then give you the opportunity to practice it during a live writing activity and assign homework based on the lesson. Of note, I use GoogleDocs for teaching, so if you are from China you will need a VPN to participate in my writing lessons.

pro_course_detail.title: English Conversational Coaching for Kids
pro_course_detail.description:
Hi! I've been teaching kids of all ages in several countries for many years. I am a certified teacher in Canada and have worked in Europe, Asia and the Middle East. My passion is working with young people on self-development in a safe and age-appropriate manner.  Please read on to see more about what I offer in this lesson. 

Many students seek conversational classes, yet figuring out "what to talk about" can be a challenge for both teacher and student. As such, I offer conversation classes grounded in co-active and transformational coaching principles—an approach that is ideal for kids who love to share and reflect on their thoughts and feelings, as well as for those who may find this, and other social-emotional skills, more challenging.

My sessions provide a supportive environment where students can:

a) share their thoughts, explore questions that help them reflect, challenge themselves, and advance their thinking. This is the coaching element that forms the foundation of our sessions.

b) ask questions about English, clarify anything they don’t fully understand, and receive feedback on their communication. This English language support component of the lesson occurs as needed throughout the session or at the end, tailored to each student’s needs.

Students are encouraged to share what’s on their mind and will then engage with questions that promote self-reflection, critical thinking, and problem-solving. By blending educational coaching best practices with language development, my approach builds resilience, confidence, and a genuine connection to both the topics they care about and their English language skills.

pro_course_detail.title: English Conversational Coaching for Adults
pro_course_detail.description:
Many adults seek conversational classes but often find it challenging to identify meaningful topics for discussion. To address this, I offer conversation classes rooted in co-active and transformational coaching principles.

My sessions create a safe, supportive environment where you can:

a) share your thoughts about things that are troubling you and engage in questions that encourage reflection, self-challenge, and forward movement in your thinking. This coaching aspect forms the core of our sessions.

b) ask questions about English, clarify any uncertainties, and receive constructive feedback on communication. This language support can occur during the session, at the end, or as a combination of both.

You'll be encouraged to discuss topics that are relevant to you, responding to targeted questions that promote self-reflection, critical thinking, and problem-solving. Combining best practices from educational coaching with language development, my approach fosters resilience, confidence, and engagement in both your personal growth and English language skills.

The International Coaching Federation defines coaching as:
"partnering with clients in a thought-provoking and creative process that inspires them to maximize their personal and professional potential. The process of coaching often unlocks previously untapped sources of imagination, productivity and leadership."

teacher_info.about_teacher: I've been teaching English for seven years, since graduating from the University of British Columbia with a Bachelor's Degree in Philosophy. I love teaching motivated students, and find the work to be incredibly fulfilling. It's a great opportunity to meet interesting people and connect with the world!
teacher_info.teaching_style:
My general teaching style is conversational, as I believe the best way to learn and develop skills is to find and pursue your own personal interests in the topic. You can learn (and more importantly, remember) far more from a conversation about life than from going through a verb conjugations test for the 50th time!

This said, I also absolutely love any opportunity to get into serious English grammar, and I am available to answer any question that a student might have about the language -- from word definitions and the differences between synonyms, to gerunds and adverbs. :)

exp_info.description: I taught as an Assistant English Teacher in a high school in El Escorial, near Madrid, Spain. It was valuable experience for teaching in a completely foreign environment, with a range of students, some with no English experience and some completely fluent.

I taught native English speakers who were having difficulty in middle/high school, due either to environmental challenges or to slight learning disabilities. It was a wonderful experience to learn how to teach kids from different angles, and see how with just the right application of teaching, they could thrive just as much as anyone else.

pro_course_detail.title: Job Interview Intensive Training
pro_course_detail.description:
This is an intensive course for students who have a job interview that they need rapid help from a highly experienced professional. 

In my over 25 years working at a senior level in English-speaking corporations, I have interviewed a vast number of candidates for roles. I have significant real experience in what makes an interviewer pass or fail a candidate. 

It is my job in these classes to coach you so that you answer questions correctly in a business-like way, using clear language that demonstrates you are business-like and have the experience. 

We will work though the most likely questions you will be asked, as well as job-specific questions. We will role play interviews, where I will be the interviewer and you will be answering.  Practical advice given as to what is the best way to answer. This is all so that you go into your real job interview much more confident and much better prepared.

pro_course_detail.title: Intensive 10 week Business English Course (includes homework).
pro_course_detail.description:
This course is designed specifically for students who need to gain Business English skills in a rapid amount of time for a new job, promotion or new work responsibilities. 

My over 25 years working at senior levels in English-speaking corporations, as well as my MBA, have given me huge practical experience that I am keen to share with you. 

Note:  This course is only for those students who are committed to rapid improvement. You will need to commit to a minimum two 60-minute lessons per week. In addition, I will also set 90 minutes of homework between classes. There is a 20-lesson curriculum that I will send you when you sign up. 

The topics covered will include the specific types of language and style we use in business, how to negotiate in English-speaking business situations, how to conduct a business meeting, negotiations and persuasion, managing difficult clients and colleagues, business ethics and corporate culture, etc. 

Each lesson involves you being placed in scenarios. We will act out situations to test your Business English, and real-time feedback will be provided on your English and style. 

Naturally, if you are not enjoying the course you can apply for a refund of the lessons you have not yet taken.
